bio: Shiro has been famed for serving traditional Japanese cuisine since 1989. In this intimate restaurant you will discover all the delights of kaiseki-ryori cuisine – a traditional interplay of intense flavours and subtle textures. Sushi made with the finest rice and ultra-fresh fish (it's best to order sushi when you make your reservation), beautifully crispy shrimp tempura, a deeply aromatic teriyaki sauce... Accompanied by exciting sake recommendations courtesy of your hostess....
